UnitStatement: AGENTS.md indexes the agent suite.
docs/TYPES.md section 4 defines classification semantics for the agent suite.
docs/DBM_Agent_Instruction_Architecture.md provides the full design basis for the agent suite.
Agent instruction files use AGENT_* filenames.
Agents use the role name as the agent name.
Agent instruction files are stored in agents/.
Agent Matrix rows describe epistemic posture.
Agent Matrix columns describe functional role.
NORMATIVE and EVALUATIVE rows open in WORKBENCH interactive mode.
The OPERATIVE row opens in PIPELINE task-execution mode.
The row structure forms a governance grammar.
NORMATIVE defines rules and standards.
OPERATIVE executes bounded work within NORMATIVE rules and standards.
EVALUATIVE audits, reconciles, and judges results.
Packages assembled from accepted upstream truth but not themselves authoritative decomposition truth are derivative packages.
Regenerated KTY-local artifacts, _Aggregation outputs, hypergraph snapshots, audit snapshots, concordance packages, and publication packages are derivative packages.
Derivative packages must cite their accepted upstream snapshots.
Derivative packages must not be treated as substitutes for decomposition truth.
Every phase-boundary decision that changes or validates governed state must terminate in a new immutable snapshot.
Pointer updates are permitted only where the owning workflow explicitly allows them.
Later phases consume accepted snapshots rather than relying on mutable working state alone.
Workflows that stop with work intended for another agent or later phase must emit an explicit handoff state.
Handoff state must name accepted upstream snapshots, derivative-package status, closure verdict, rerun requirements, and remaining blockers.
A scope unit or phase is not closed merely because files were written.
Closure requires authoritative truth to be accepted.
Closure requires required derivative packages to be regenerated or explicitly deferred.
Closure requires audit status to be recorded.
Closure requires unresolved blockers to be surfaced in the handoff state.
Later phases that consume derivative packages must run only after upstream authoritative snapshots have been accepted.
Required handoff state must record which derivative packages are current before later phases consume derivative packages.
The NORMATIVE GUIDING cell maps to HELP_HUMAN.
The NORMATIVE APPLYING cell maps to ORCHESTRATOR.
The NORMATIVE JUDGING cell maps to WORKING_ITEMS.
The NORMATIVE REVIEWING cell maps to AGGREGATION.
The OPERATIVE GUIDING cell maps to DECOMP*.
The OPERATIVE APPLYING cell maps to PREPARATION.
The OPERATIVE JUDGING cell maps to TASK.
The OPERATIVE REVIEWING cell maps to AUDIT*.
The EVALUATIVE GUIDING cell maps to HELPS_HUMANS.
The EVALUATIVE APPLYING cell maps to DBM_PUBLISHER.
The EVALUATIVE JUDGING cell maps to CHANGE.
The EVALUATIVE REVIEWING cell maps to RECONCILIATION.
PREPARATION and TASK cells name canonical shells directly.
DECOMP*, AUDIT*, PDF2MD*, and DRAWING_EXTRACT* wildcard cells expand to agent groups by PipelineCategory.
DECOMP* includes PROJECT_DECOMP, SOFTWARE_DECOMP, DOMAIN_DECOMP, and SCOPE_CHANGE.
PDF2MD* includes PDF2MD.
DRAWING_EXTRACT* includes DRAWING_EXTRACT.

AUDIT* includes AUDIT_AGENTS, AUDIT_DECOMP, AUDIT_DEP_CLOSURE, AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE, AUDIT_GOVERNANCE, AUDIT_EPISTEMIC, AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE, EVALUATION_REPORT, EVALUATION_STRUCTURE_AUDIT, and EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.
DELIVERABLE_TASK, AGGREGATION, and DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH are live task-family agents indexed by type.
Archived wrapper-agent methods are dispatched through TASK plus TaskSkill.
HELPS_HUMANS uses AGENT_HELPS_HUMANS.md as the workflow design standard governing agents, skills, and tools.
All workflow components must conform to HELPS_HUMANS.
DECOMP_BASE uses AGENT_DECOMP_BASE.md as the decomposition protocol standard for the 7-gate, I1-I10 protocol.
HELP_HUMAN uses AGENT_HELP_HUMAN.md for operator assistance that classifies intent and drafts briefs.
ORCHESTRATOR uses AGENT_ORCHESTRATOR.md for project setup, tier sequencing, and control loops.
WORKING_ITEMS uses AGENT_WORKING_ITEMS.md for deliverable-scoped content production.
RECONCILIATION uses AGENT_RECONCILIATION.md for cross-deliverable coherence analysis.
CHANGE uses AGENT_CHANGE.md for git state management with approval gates.
PROJECT_DECOMP uses AGENT_PROJECT_DECOMP.md for EPC and design-build decomposition.
SOFTWARE_DECOMP uses AGENT_SOFTWARE_DECOMP.md for software decomposition with Context Envelopes.
DOMAIN_DECOMP uses AGENT_DOMAIN_DECOMP.md for handbook and knowledge-domain decomposition.
SCOPE_CHANGE uses AGENT_SCOPE_CHANGE.md for change impact assessment and decomposition amendment.
DOMAIN_ENGINE uses AGENT_DOMAIN_ENGINE.md for domain-engine integration management.
DOMAIN_ENGINE manages profiles, protected paths, adapter workflows, operation proposals, and human-gated domain handoffs.
CONTEXT_TRANSPOSE uses AGENT_CONTEXT_TRANSPOSE.md for cross-context structural transposition.
REVIEW uses AGENT_REVIEW.md for formal 5-gate review of lifecycle transitions.
SCHEDULING uses AGENT_SCHEDULING.md for schedule generation from a dependency graph.
EVALUATION uses AGENT_EVALUATION.md for project evaluation orchestration.
TOOLMAKER uses AGENT_TOOLMAKER.md for deterministic tool design and implementation.
SKILLMAKER uses AGENT_SKILLMAKER.md for skill design, governance, and subsystem ownership.
PDF2MD uses AGENT_PDF2MD.md for native PDF-to-Markdown conversion.
PDF2MD orchestrates rasterization, batch VLM dispatch, post-processing, optional prose asset materialization, and assembly.
EQUATION_AUDIT uses AGENT_EQUATION_AUDIT.md for the post-PDF2MD equation-review loop.
EQUATION_AUDIT iterates extract, human review, prose-note interpretation, fixes, re-extraction, backcheck, and closure.
EQUATION_AUDIT terminates equation audit work in an immutable snapshot under audit/equations/snapshots/.
EQUATION_AUDIT dispatches equation-flag-interpret for each prose-shaped flagged equation.
EQUATION_AUDIT dispatches equation-bbox-detect per page when crops are enabled.
DRAWING_EXTRACT uses AGENT_DRAWING_EXTRACT.md for drawing-type-aware extraction.
DRAWING_EXTRACT applies a core-vs-repertoire split across rasterization, crop or tile selection, target-specific TASK skill dispatch, QA, assembly, and optional PFD-equipment merge.
DRAWING_EXTRACT implements DRAWING_SET, PFD, and P_AND_ID targets.
DRAWING_EXTRACT leaves ISOMETRIC and GA targets stubbed fail-fast.
DBM_PUBLISHER uses AGENT_DBM_PUBLISHER.md to publish one rewritten DBM from approved DOMAIN state.
DBM_PUBLISHER uses frozen planning artifacts, direct section dispatch, package assembly, and post-authoring evidence-bundle review.
PREPARATION uses AGENT_PREPARATION.md to scaffold package and deliverable folders.
AGGREGATION uses AGENT_AGGREGATION.md for cross-scope synthesis snapshots.
TASK uses AGENT_TASK.md as a generic bounded-task shell that loads profile and skill within explicit scope.
DELIVERABLE_TASK uses AGENT_DELIVERABLE_TASK.md as a preserved deliverable-local SME helper workflow.
AUDIT_AGENTS uses AGENT_AUDIT_AGENTS.md for agent-instruction conformance audit.
AUDIT_DECOMP uses AGENT_AUDIT_DECOMP.md for decomposition coverage audit.
AUDIT_DEP_CLOSURE uses AGENT_AUDIT_DEP_CLOSURE.md for dependency closure audit.
DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH uses AGENT_DOMAIN_HYPERGRAPH.md for hypergraph snapshot generation.
AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE uses AGENT_AUDIT_HYPERGRAPH_CLOSURE.md for hypergraph closure audit.
AUDIT_GOVERNANCE uses AGENT_AUDIT_GOVERNANCE.md for governance document consistency audit.
AUDIT_EPISTEMIC uses AGENT_AUDIT_EPISTEMIC.md for deliverable epistemic ontology audit.
AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE uses AGENT_AUDIT_SCOPE_CLOSURE.md for scope change closure audit.
EVALUATION_REPORT uses AGENT_EVALUATION_REPORT.md for scored dimension evaluation.
EVALUATION_STRUCTURE_AUDIT uses AGENT_EVALUATION_STRUCTURE_AUDIT.md for structural validation.
EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT uses AGENT_EVALUATION_DEPENDENCY_AUDIT.md for dependency validation.
TASK dispatches repo-native method packs through TaskSkill names.
The authoritative skill inventory is the set of immediate skills/ subdirectories that contain SKILL.md.
skills/README.md governs the skill inventory.
tools/validation/validate_skill_metadata.py validates the skill inventory.
AGENTS.md is not the complete skill registry.
AGENTS.md lists only canonical dispatch relationships needed to understand the agent architecture.
Full skill membership, folder contracts, legacy status, and discovery rules are in skills/README.md and target skill folders.
ORCHESTRATOR dispatches setup, decomposition-support, document-production, semantic, dependency, and estimation skills as required by the active phase.
ORCHESTRATOR uses skills/README.md and live skills/*/SKILL.md files for the current skill inventory.
SCOPE_CHANGE dispatches bounded remediation and decomposition-package review skills for closure support.
WORKING_ITEMS and DELIVERABLE_TASK dispatch deliverable-local production, consistency, proposal-format, equipment, and content-digest skills when the brief selects them.
PDF2MD dispatches TASK plus pdf2md-page for per-page transcription.
PDF2MD dispatches TASK plus pdf2md-page-assets for page-bounded asset discovery when ASSET_MODE is prose.
TASK plus pdf2md is available for smaller single-run conversions where full PDF2MD orchestration is unnecessary.
EQUATION_AUDIT dispatches TASK plus equation-flag-interpret for each flagged equation whose description is a natural-language note.
EQUATION_AUDIT dispatches TASK plus equation-bbox-detect per page when ENABLE_CROPS is true and the page contains display equations.
DRAWING_EXTRACT dispatches drawing-extract-page, drawing-titleblock-page, and pandid-valve-symbol-instance according to the registry in AGENT_DRAWING_EXTRACT.md.
DBM_PUBLISHER dispatches TASK plus dbm-section-publish for section synthesis.
DBM_PUBLISHER dispatches TASK plus dbm-publish for package assembly and readiness artifacts.
DBM_PUBLISHER dispatches TASK plus dbm-postauthor-concordance for post-authoring evidence-bundle review.
DBM_PUBLISHER may dispatch TASK plus dbm-concordance-verify when optional semantic cross-section review is selected.
DOMAIN_DECOMP dispatches TASK plus domain-source-atomize once per skeleton-dispatch-unit during Phase 2.
DOMAIN_DECOMP atomization uses per-source fan-out of about 15k Markdown tokens per unit.
DOMAIN_DECOMP atomization expects about 85-125 dispatches across a five-book corpus.
tools/decomp/build_source_skeleton.py produces the dispatch plan for DOMAIN_DECOMP atomization.
tools/decomp/build_atomization_brief.py renders per-unit briefs for DOMAIN_DECOMP atomization.
Per-unit CSVs merge into per-source and cross-source ledgers via tools/decomp/merge_source_atomizations.py.
Active skill status must not be inferred from older narrative lists.
When AGENTS.md, skills/README.md, and live skill folders disagree, the live skill folder plus skills/README.md are the current skill registry.
Discrepancies among AGENTS.md, skills/README.md, and live skill folders must be surfaced.
